items.V1t: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra, described as its most capable broadly deployed model, on 3 September 2026, priced at $10 per million input tokens and $50 per million output tokens.
items.V1f: OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra as an open-weights model in July 2026, free for anyone to download and run locally.
items.V2t: On 2 August 2026, OPEC+ approved a final 188,000 barrel-per-day production increase for September 2026, completing the rollback of the voluntary cuts first announced in 2023.
items.V2f: In August 2026, OPEC+ reversed course and announced an emergency 2-million-barrel-per-day production cut in response to the Gulf shipping crisis.
items.V3t: As of late September 2026, the Strait of Hormuz remained effectively closed to commercial traffic — about one transit per day against a pre-war baseline of roughly 85 — after the June 2026 interim reopening collapsed; on 26 September President Trump rejected Iran's seven-day roadmap to reopen it.
items.V3f: The Strait of Hormuz returned to full normal commercial traffic in September 2026, with daily transits back to pre-war levels of roughly 85 to 140 vessels.
items.V4t: In September 2026, captured Venezuelan president Nicolás Maduro petitioned a New York federal court to dismiss the drug-trafficking charges against him, claiming head-of-state immunity; his trial is scheduled to begin in June 2027.
items.V4f: In September 2026, a New York jury convicted Nicolás Maduro of narco-terrorism and sentenced him to 30 years in prison.
items.V5t: In late September 2026, the United States and China announced a trade deal under which each side cuts tariffs on about $30 billion of the other's goods; the US published its 77-product list on 27 September 2026.
items.V5f: In September 2026, the United States and China signed a comprehensive free trade agreement eliminating all tariffs between the two countries.
items.V6t: At its DevDay on 29 September 2026, OpenAI announced Dots — always-on ChatGPT agents, each running on GPT-6 Astra with its own cloud computer and browser.
items.V6f: OpenAI's Dots agents announced at DevDay 2026 are powered by Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5.

items.V7f: Ayatollah Ali Khamenei survived the February 2026 strikes and publicly led Friday prayers in Tehran in July 2026.
